translations.translatedText: # Sunday 19.6.2022 (radio)
Lowering of taxes. Wille Rydman. The French election. The Jukola relay. The weather.
## Taxes

![Prime Minister's interview hour at Kesäranta on 19.6.2022.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3500,h_1968,x_0,y_276/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97221462af188437091/1655653708)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin was in a radio interview on Sunday. The programme's name is Prime Minister's interview hour. Photo: Fanni Uusitalo / Prime Minister's Office
The debate on lowering taxes continues. The reason is that prices have risen so much that many people have difficulty making the money last.
Prime Minister Sanna Marin said in a radio interview on Sunday that lowering taxes is one way to help people.
Many economic experts think that lowering taxes is the wrong way to make up for the rise in prices. According to experts, if taxes fall, it may even increase the rise in prices, that is, inflation.
Marin says that the government is, however, considering the matter. According to Marin, lowering taxes does not increase inflation if it is done at the right time.
## Wille Rydman

![National Coalition Party MP Wille Rydman at a press briefing of the Constitutional Law Committee in Helsinki on 17 June 2020.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_151/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97216862aee94eb4de6/1655630225)
Open image viewer
MP Wille Rydman. Photo: Emmi Korhonen / Lehtikuva
Helsingin Sanomat writes that National Coalition Party MP Wille Rydman has behaved badly towards young women.
Rydman himself says that the claims are not true.
The police have looked into the matter. The police do not suspect that Rydman has committed a crime.
The National Coalition Party still intends to look into what has happened.
## French election
![French people voting at a polling station.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5120,h_2880,x_0,y_427/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97217262aeeaf66feb8/1655630686)
Open image viewer
The French people voted on Sunday. Photo: Ludovic Marin / AFP
The French people have voted in the parliamentary elections. On Sunday the second round of the French parliamentary election was held.
A week ago the first round of the election was held. Then the centre-right alliance and the left-wing alliance got equal amounts of votes.
The result was difficult for President Emmanuel Macron, who leads the centre-right alliance. Macron needs the support of a parliamentary majority in order to carry out his own policy.
Opinion polls predict that in the second round of the election Macron's alliance has the chance to get a majority in parliament.
## Jukola relay
![Jukola magic.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_297/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97216562aee879a4066/1655629991)
Open image viewer
The Jukola relay is run at night. Photo: Tomi Hänninen
The Swedish team Stora Tuna has won the Jukola relay. The relay orienteering competition was run during the night between Saturday and Sunday in the forests of Mynämäki.
Stora Tuna's team had 4 brothers. The team also won the 2 previous Jukola relays.
The Jukola relay is the world's largest relay orienteering competition. This year 3000 teams and 17,000 orienteers took part.
## The weather
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12501105)
Open image viewer
The weather is becoming drier, that is, the rain decreases.
On the south coast there will still be rain and thunder showers on Monday. On Tuesday the weather becomes dry across the whole country.
The temperature is below 20 degrees on Monday. On Tuesday the weather warms up a little.
